reason: The app registered a browser subscription or a phone's device token through this tool, and nothing else ever called it: it was hidden from every model, so no fleet agent was offered it, and the plane answered it only for the app through the public API. The app and the plane deploy together, the iOS shell loading intern.kim remotely, so no device holds a caller of the tool.
release: the web deploy that carries /api/member/push-device, which the app and the plane take at once; no OTA release carries a caller
